# Proverbs 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** One-loving discipline loves knowledge, but-one-hating correction [is] brutish.

**2** A-good-[person] obtains favor from-YHWH, but-a-man-of schemes He-condemns.

**3** Not will-be-established a-man by-wickedness, but-[the]-root-of [the]-righteous will-not be-moved.

**4** A-woman-of valor [is the]-crown-of her-husband, but-like-rottenness in-his-bones [is one]-causing-shame.

**5** [The]-plans-of [the]-righteous [are] justice; [the]-counsels-of [the]-wicked [are] deceit.

**6** [The]-words-of [the]-wicked [are] an-ambush-of blood, but-[the]-mouth-of [the]-upright delivers-them.

**7** Overthrown [the]-wicked and-they-are-no-more, but-[the]-house-of [the]-righteous will-stand.

**8** According-to his-understanding a-man is-praised, but-[the]-twisted-of heart will-be-despised.

**9** Better [is one]-lightly-esteemed and-[has]-a-servant-for-himself, than-one-honoring-himself and-lacking bread.

**10** [The]-righteous knows [the]-soul-of his-beast, but-[the]-compassion-of [the]-wicked [is] cruel.

**11** One-working his-ground will-be-satisfied [with]-bread, but-one-pursuing empty-things lacks heart.

**12** [The]-wicked desires [the]-net-of evil-ones, but-[the]-root-of [the]-righteous gives [fruit].

**13** In-[the]-transgression-of [the]-lips [is] a-snare-of evil, but-[the]-righteous goes-out from-distress.

**14** From-[the]-fruit-of [the]-mouth-of a-man he-is-satisfied [with]-good, and-[the]-dealing-of a-man's hands returns to-him.

**15** [The]-way-of a-fool [is]-straight in-his-[own]-eyes, but-one-listening to-counsel [is] wise.

**16** A-fool — in-the-day his-vexation is-known, but-one-covering dishonor [is] prudent.

**17** One-breathing truth declares righteousness, but-a-witness-of falsehood [declares] deceit.

**18** There-is one-speaking like-thrusts-of a-sword, but-[the]-tongue-of [the]-wise [is] healing.

**19** A-lip-of truth is-established forever, but-only for-a-moment a-tongue-of falsehood.

**20** Deceit [is] in-[the]-heart-of devisers-of evil, but-for-counselors-of peace [there is] joy.

**21** Not will-be-allowed-to-happen to-[the]-righteous any iniquity, but-[the]-wicked are-filled [with] trouble.

**22** [An]-abomination-of YHWH [are]-lips-of falsehood, but-doers-of faithfulness [are] His-delight.

**23** A-man prudent conceals knowledge, but-[the]-heart-of fools proclaims foolishness.

**24** [The]-hand-of [the]-diligent will-rule, but-slackness will-be for-forced-labor.

**25** Anxiety in-[the]-heart-of a-man bows-it-down, but-a-word good makes-it-glad.

**26** [The]-righteous searches-out his-neighbor, but-[the]-way-of [the]-wicked leads-them-astray.

**27** Not will-roast [the]-slack his-game, but-wealth-of a-man [is] precious [to the]-diligent.

**28** In-[the]-path-of righteousness [is] life, and-[the]-way-of [its]-path [is]-no-death.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **12:4**: Eshet chayil — 'woman of valor/strength.' Same phrase as Proverbs 31:10. Crown imagery = she elevates his standing.

- **12:10**: Yode'a tzaddiq nephesh behemto — 'the righteous knows the soul of his beast.' Earliest biblical basis for animal welfare ethics.

- **12:18**: Bote ke-mad'qerot cherev — 'speaking like thrusts of a sword.' Words as weapons — a recurring Proverbs theme.

— EMET
